svg.title: Main menu · Fun Things
svg.desc: Main menu over the accepted P0-04 perspective artwork. Solo, host, join, settings and quit. Amber outline is visible keyboard/controller focus, not a selected transport or a measured game state. Concept mockup only; numbers, names and connection states are illustrative.

g.text: A LITTLE CITY. A LOT OF TROUBLE.
Take a walk. Take a car. Bring friends.
Free roam. No score. No timer.
UI V1 · CONCEPT ART BACKGROUND · BUILD LABEL RESERVED
